records.title: Arm Spectre-BHB shared branch-history behavior
records.summary: Shared branch history in the BHB can influence branch misprediction, with resulting cache effects usable for sensitive-information inference on documented affected Cortex and Neoverse processors.
affected_components: documented affected Cortex and Neoverse processors
records.trigger_summary: Shared branch history in the BHB influences branch misprediction.
records.precondition_summary: The documented branch-history and speculative-execution conditions must be present.
records.hardware_effect_summary: Cache effects from the misprediction can be used for sensitive-information inference.

records.title: Cortex-A77 erratum 1508412 software-triggered deadlock
records.summary: Public reports describe software execution around device or non-cacheable memory accesses triggering Cortex-A77 erratum 1508412, with core deadlock and system denial of service.
records.trigger_summary: A load to device or non-cacheable memory occurs in close proximity to either a store-exclusive operation or a PAR_EL1 read.
records.precondition_summary: The documented operations must occur in close proximity; the public sources do not define a precise instruction count.
records.hardware_effect_summary: The affected core may deadlock and cause system denial of service.

records.title: Xen ARM32 cache-maintenance helper arithmetic overflow
records.summary: Arithmetic in Xen ARM32 cache clean and invalidate helpers may overflow, causing cache maintenance operations for a region to be skipped.
records.trigger_summary: A region calculation in an affected cache clean or invalidate helper overflows.
records.precondition_summary: The overflowing calculation reaches the documented Xen ARM32 cache-maintenance helper path.
records.hardware_effect_summary: Cache clean or invalidate operations for the region may be skipped; a distinct target hardware vulnerability is not established.

records.title: Cortex-A520 erratum 2966298 speculative unprivileged load
records.summary: Under specific microarchitectural conditions, a speculatively executed EL0 unprivileged load may access mapped memory without EL0 permission and expose privileged data through a cache side channel.
records.trigger_summary: An EL0 unprivileged load is speculatively executed against mapped memory without EL0 permission.
records.precondition_summary: Specific microarchitectural conditions apply; the documented workaround places non-shareable TLBI followed by DSB NSH after privileged loads and before return to EL0.
records.hardware_effect_summary: Privileged data may be forwarded speculatively and leaked through a cache side channel.

records.title: Linux arm64 speculative-unprivileged-load workaround placement
records.summary: Linux arm64 placed ARM64_WORKAROUND_SPECULATIVE_UNPRIV_LOAD before a later LDR even though TLBI and DSB must follow all explicit memory accesses before return to EL0.
records.trigger_summary: The affected entry path places the workaround before a later explicit LDR.
records.precondition_summary: The corrected semantic sequence is last explicit memory access, TLBI, DSB, then ERET.
records.hardware_effect_summary: The software problem concerns workaround ordering for the listed Cortex-A510 and Cortex-A520 errata.

records.title: Arm CMSE floating-point register secure-stack disclosure
records.summary: Under the documented Secure-to-Non-secure floating-return condition, LLVM-based compiler-generated code may expose Secure stack contents through floating-point registers.
records.trigger_summary: Compiler-generated code returns a floating-point value from Secure to Non-secure state under the documented condition.
records.precondition_summary: The documented Secure-to-Non-secure floating-return condition applies.
records.hardware_effect_summary: Secure stack contents may leak through floating-point registers.

records.title: Arm TLBI and DSB completion ordering issue
records.summary: Public reports describe affected Arm families where broadcast TLBI plus DSB completion may precede global observation of affected writes, potentially allowing writes to resources owned by a higher exception level.
records.trigger_summary: An affected broadcast TLBI and DSB sequence completes before affected writes are globally observed.
records.precondition_summary: The behavior depends on completion and global observation across affected execution; the documented mitigation repeats an affected TLBI and DSB sequence.
records.hardware_effect_summary: Writes to resources owned by a higher exception level may be possible.
